notes: original_listed_time is used as the initial posting date.
Remote status is Remote tagged or Unknown / not supplied; unknown is not treated as onsite.
Salary metrics use annualized USD values from YEARLY, HOURLY, MONTHLY, and WEEKLY postings between $10,000 and $500,000.
Technology demand represents deterministic description mentions, not manually verified required skills.
No descriptions, URLs, API responses, or secrets are included.
